arguments.text: Which AI tools are approved for staff, and may restricted information be used with them? The Institute provides an enterprise AI assistant integrated with its document platform, and an enterprise chat service with data retention switched off. Both are approved tools. Consumer AI services, browser extensions, and personal accounts are not approved for Institute work. Public and internal information may be used with the approved enterprise AI tools. Restricted information must never be pasted or uploaded into any AI tool that sends data outside the Institute's own environment, including approved external chat services. Restricted information may only be processed by models hosted inside the Institute's private cloud, after a data protection review. How long do we keep AI prompts and outputs, and when do they become records? Prompts and outputs from approved AI tools are not records by default. When an AI output is used in a decision or a publication, the final version is filed with the related record and follows that record's retention period.
